server_offline.title: Server {{server}} is offline
server_offline.body: The agent on {{server}} has not been connected for {{minutes}} minutes. Websites on it may be down.

server_disk.title: Disk almost full on {{server}}
server_disk.body: The disk of {{server}} is {{percent}}% full. Free some space before websites and databases stop writing.

certificate_expiring.title: The certificate of {{name}} expires soon
certificate_expiring.body: It expires on {{date}}. Upload a new one, or switch the site back to a free certificate.

quota_warning.title: Disk space almost used up
quota_warning.body: {{customer}} uses {{used}} of {{limit}}. When it is full, files and new websites cannot be added.

quota_full.title: Disk space used up
quota_full.body: {{customer}} uses {{used}} of {{limit}}. Files and new websites cannot be added until some space is freed.

login_new_ip.title: New sign-in to your account
login_new_ip.body: Someone signed in to your ekPanel account from {{ip}}. If it was not you, change your password and sign out other devices.

test.title: Test notification from ekPanel
test.body: This channel works. You will get notifications here.
